name: 01_quorum_with_self_exclusion
description: CROSS-CORE GUARD for corroborate — the faker-resistant self-excluded-quorum count (named in the CONTRIBUTING equivalence invariant) had only per-core unit tests; this is the first SHARED vector both cores read. quorum=2. Subjects at the device level: D is attested by THREE independent reporters (A, B, C) AND vouches for itself (the D->D self-vote MUST be excluded by inst != option) — 3 independent >= 2 so D materializes 1.0. E is a faker with exactly ONE genuine independent reporter (B) PLUS its own self-vote (E->E); self-exclusion means the self-vote does NOT count, so E has 1 independent < quorum — NOT materialized. This is the load-bearing self-exclusion edge: if self-exclusion broke, E's self-vote would tip it to count 2 and FALSELY materialize. F is attested by exactly ONE independent reporter (A) — count 1 == quorum-1, just BELOW threshold — NOT materialized. G is attested by exactly TWO independent reporters (A, B) — count 2 == quorum, exactly AT threshold — materializes 1.0. A reporter that writes a non-positive (0.0) attestation for subject H (from A) does NOT count (the > 0 attestation test), leaving H with 1 positive (B) — below quorum — NOT materialized. This pins all four decision edges of corroborate: self-exclusion (E), the >0 attestation gate (H), and the quorum boundary on both sides (F ==quorum-1 absent, G ==quorum present). The `materialized` list is the EXACT set of cells that must exist at the toLevel after corroborate; every `absent` subject must read None. Captured from the live corroborate on both cores.
